name: Meowdoku!
description:
Looking for a game that soothes the soul but keeps your brain spinning? Welcome to Meowdoku — a pure logic puzzle game that flawlessly blends the rigorous reasoning of Sudoku with the thrilling deduction of Minesweeper.

Here, you have only one mission: find the perfect "exclusive territory" for every aloof little cat!
Simple Rules, Deep Strategy

The concept is elegant and intuitive, yet anything but simple:
• Exclusive Territory: The board is divided into colored sections. You must place exactly one cat in each section.
• The Aloof Rule: Cats need absolute personal space! They absolutely cannot share the same row, column, or touch each other—not even diagonally.
• Risk & Reward: Double-tap a tile to place a cat. You only have 3 chances to make a mistake (hearts). Guess right, and you're rewarded with pure puzzle-solving satisfaction; guess wrong, and you lose a heart. Guessing won't save you; every single move must be carefully calculated!

Key Features
• Pure & Immersive Experience
• Non-Intrusive Ads: Zero interruptions to your gameplay, letting you fully enjoy a completely focused, Zen-like flow state.
• Play Offline Anytime: No internet required. Perfectly fills up the puzzle-shaped hole in your daily commute, time spent waiting in line, or your morning coffee break.

Wake up your mind with brand-new "Daily Puzzles" every single day.
Push your limits and see if you can break your fastest completion times on the global leaderboards. Why Meowdoku Will Stay on Your Phone Meowdoku won't hijack your attention with tedious social mechanics or endless daily grinds—it earns your love through pure gameplay quality. With its minimalist aesthetic and satisfying tactile feedback, it takes just seconds to learn. Yet, long after you put your phone down, its elegant logic loop will keep lingering in your mind. Ready for a brain-teasing puzzle adventure filled with adorable felines? Download Meowdoku now, put your logic to the test, and become the ultimate feline puzzle master!

Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!

Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!

Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.

Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.

name: Vita Mahjong
description:
Vita Mahjong is an Exclusive Solitaire Puzzle Game for Senior Citizens. We are thrilled to present the matching game that combines innovation with classic gameplay. It offers large tiles and a user-friendly, eye-friendly interface compatible with tablets and mobile phones of all sizes and shapes. Our goal is to provide a gaming experience that's relaxing yet mentally engaging, focusing particularly on older adults.

At Vita Studio, we have always been dedicated to crafting mobile games designed for seniors that bring back relaxation, fun, and joy. Our repertoire includes popular titles like Vita Solitaire, Vita Color, Vita Jigsaw, Vita Word Search, Vita Block, and more.

Why Choose Vita Mahjong?
Studies have shown that mentally stimulating activities like mahjong solitaire puzzles help preserve mental acuity. However, many puzzle games today are not tailored to the unique needs of senior citizens. Recognizing this gap, we created a game specifically for seniors' requirements and preferences, combining mental stimulation with accessibility and ease of use.

How to Play Vita Mahjong:
Playing Vita Mahjong Solitaire is simple. Just aim to clear all the tiles on the board by matching tiles with identical images. Tap or slide two matching tiles, and they will vanish from the board. Your objective is to match tiles that are not concealed or blocked. The puzzles become more challenging as you progress, enhancing your wisdom. Once all tiles are eliminated, it signifies successful completion of a mahjong solitaire puzzle!

Exclusive Vita Mahjong Solitaire Game Features:
• Classic Mahjong Solitaire: Staying true to the original gameplay, it presents traditional card tile sets and hundreds of game boards for endless entertainment.
• Special Innovations: Besides the classic, our game introduces surprises such as special tiles that add a fresh twist to the classic gameplay.
• Large-Scale Design: Our puzzles feature large, easily readable text sizes to alleviate the strain caused by small fonts.
• Active Mind Levels: A special gameplay mode designed to sharpen your mind and improve memory abilities. The objective is to match the pairing tiles you have seen at this unique level.
• Helpful Hints: Our game provides useful props, such as hints, undo, and shuffle, to help players overcome challenging puzzles when they're stuck.
• Daily Challenge: Take on daily challenges, collect trophies, and improve your skills. This daily practice consistently exercises your brain.
• Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you enjoy Vita Mahjong anytime, anywhere, without needing Wi-Fi or internet connectivity.
• Multi-device: Optimized for smartphones and tablets, ensuring everyone can enjoy the challenge regardless of their device.

By emphasizing accessibility and ease of use along with elements of mental stimulation, Vita Mahjong Solitaire offers seniors a free game tailored to their unique preferences.

Start your amazing tile-matching solitaire adventure with Vita Mahjong now!

description:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.
 
Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

Welcome to Colony Flow — a relaxing ant colony puzzle where every tiny ant has a job to do! Tap a box, watch the workers pour out, and send them marching up to the pixel picture to carry colorful blocks back to the nest, one busy trip at a time.

Each level gives you a stack of ant boxes and just five open slots. Tap a box and it slides into a slot, releasing a swarm of ants in that color — they'll haul away every matching block in the picture. Clear a box and the slot frees up for the next one.

That's where the thinking starts. Open a color that has nothing left to carry and that slot stays clogged. Fill all five and your colony grinds to a halt. Read the picture, count what's left, and choose your boxes in the right order to keep the ants flowing.

COMMAND YOUR COLONY

- Watch workers haul matching blocks back to the nest

With adorable ants, satisfying animations, soothing music, and no time pressure, Colony Flow is easy to pick up and gentle to play — the kind of game that fits into a coffee break, a commute, or a quiet evening on the couch. But clearing every level will take some clever planning.

name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
description:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one hand
-  No timer, no pressure - relax at your own pace
- Levels designed to surprise - no two boards look the same
- 2× speed mode for snappier ant action

EASY TO LEARN. HARD TO STOP.
Early levels are breezy. Later levels pack in more colors, tighter slots, and bigger images that demand real planning.

Which color do you clear first? When do you free a slot before it jams? Every tap matters.

A true logic brain teaser - wrapped in pixel art you'll actually enjoy destroying.

WHY YOU CHOOSE FOOD HUNT?
Most color sort games show you an empty grid and ask you to fill it. Food Hunt flips it - every board starts full, alive with pixel art, and your only goal is to wipe it clean.
Same satisfying sort. A completely different feeling. 

Download Food Hunt - the color sort puzzle where the art is the game.

name: Z Route: Redemption
description:
The world has turned to ash, dominated by zombies. Z Route—it is your final path to redemption, and the last battleground of the apocalypse. With nowhere to hide, you can only advance, weapon ready! Redemption or doom? The choice is in your hands!​​
​Crash through every gate of choice and tear through the horde amid roaring engines. Only speed and ruthlessness will keep you alive. Are you ready? This is your war.

​- Trust Your Alliance​
In an apocalypse, no one survives alone. Recruit warriors with different specialties and build the ultimate squad. Strategy and teamwork are your only path to survival.
- ​Choose Wisely​
Every gate is a gamble between life and death. Choose right, and you'll find supplies. Choose wrong, and face the horde. Time is short, so you must decide fast. ​Only the smartest and toughest will achieve redemption!​​
​- Arm Yourself​
The stronger your weapon, the better your chances. But fate is fickle; survival also depends on luck.
​- Speedrun Stages​
Speed is your shield. Dash, dodge, counter—don't stop! Only by pushing forward can you keep death at bay.
​- Conquer Powerful Enemies​
You never know what monsters await you at the end of the road. The only thing you can do is to keep arming yourself and be ready for anything!

Download Z Route: Redemption now!​​ Gear up and make your stand. Danger lurks everywhere on the highway of death. Your battle has already begun. Never back down. Survival favors the bold!

name: Lordrush
description:
Lordrush is a medieval tower defense strategy game where you rebuild a ruined fortress and defend your realm from attacks.

Gather resources, raise defenses, upgrade towers, and recruit heroes as you prepare for each assault.

Set in a harsh medieval world of stone castles, armored heroes, war-torn battlefields, and rival lords, Lordrush blends fortress building, resource management, hero strategy, and tactical defense.


• Fight for Resources
Wood, stone, and iron are essential for expansion. Compete with exiles, rebels, and other forces for control of vital resources.

• Build Fortress Walls
Construct defensive walls to slow enemy advances and give your towers more time to strike.

• Upgrade Towers
Place and upgrade towers to expand your firepower, increase damage, and hold key defensive positions.

• Strengthen Your Fortress
As enemy attacks grow stronger, reinforce your walls, expand your towers, and turn your settlement into a powerful medieval stronghold.

• Defend Against Sieges
Enemies attack your fortress in waves. Adjust your defenses based on enemy routes and strength, and hold the line.

• Recruit Heroes
Recruit medieval heroes with different abilities. Deploy them to change the course of battle.

• Make Tactical Choices
Every building, upgrade, and hero deployment can affect the outcome. Plan carefully to survive the next siege.

• Manage Your People
Assign survivors as workers, hunters, or cooks to maintain resource production, food supplies, and daily fortress operations.

• Maintain Health and Order
Your people’s condition affects productivity. Keep food stocked, maintain stability, and help your fortress continue to grow.

• Issue Decrees
Set rules under pressure from scarce resources and outside threats. Maintain order and guide the growth of your stronghold.

• Join Alliances
Create or join alliances, share resources, coordinate defenses, and face powerful enemies together.

• Challenge Other Lords
Train heroes, build squads, and compete for points, rare rewards, and greater influence across the continent.

• Claim the Throne
Start from a single fortress, build your defenses, gather resources, expand your power, and become a lord who cannot be ignored.

name: Pixel Flow!
developer: Loom Games Oyun Yazilim ve Pazarlama Anonim Sirketi
description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

name: Number Match - Numbers Game
description:
Number Match is an addictive puzzle game with simple rules: match pairs and clear the board to succeed. Playing Number Match is a useful pastime for your brain. Train your logic and concentration skills, and try to beat your high score!

Try a mobile version of the pen and paper game from your childhood. Now you can take your number game with you wherever you go. Solving free Number Match puzzles on mobile is much easier than using a pencil and paper.

How to play:

• The goal is to clear the board.
• Find pairs of equal numbers (1 and 1, 7 and 7) or pairs that add up to 10 (6 and 4, 8 and 2) on the number grid.
• Tap on the numbers one by one to cross out them and get points.
• You can connect pairs in adjacent horizontal, vertical and diagonal cells, as well as at the end of one line and the beginning of the next.
• When you run out of moves, you can add extra lines with the remaining numbers at the bottom.
• Speed up your progress with Hints if you are stuck.
• You win after all numbers are removed from the number puzzle grid.

There are a lot of ways to solve the puzzle. But it’s not as easy as it seems. Tease your brain and enjoy an engaging experience!

What you get:

• Easy-to-learn logic puzzle
• Hours of gameplay for you to enjoy
• Daily challenges to win unique trophies
• Seasonal events to get unique medals
• Hints to help you reach the goal faster
• No time limit, so no rush, just relax
• New numbers game from a top developer!

Challenge your brain with Number Match puzzles and have fun! Play the number game anywhere, anytime!

name: Merge Bubbles - Word Game
description:
Merge Bubbles is a fresh and satisfying word puzzle game combining word associations with relaxing bubble merging gameplay. Merge matching word bubbles, discover hidden categories, and complete clever word groups in this addictive brain-training adventure.

Each bubble contains a word. Your goal is simple: merge related words together. When you successfully collect 4 words from the same category, you complete the set and unlock more bubbles to continue your journey.

Easy to learn but challenging to master! Merge Bubbles combines relaxing gameplay with smart word association puzzles that will test your vocabulary and logic.

Whether you enjoy word games, matching puzzles, or relaxing brain teasers, Merge Bubbles offers a unique and rewarding experience.

HOW TO PLAY:
- Merge word bubbles together: Find words that belong to the same category and merge their bubbles.
- Complete categories: Collect 4 related words to finish a category and clear space on the board.
- Unlock new bubbles: As you progress, more word bubbles drop into your level, creating new challenges and opportunities.
- Think ahead: Plan your merges carefully to avoid passing your move count.

Angry Birds features challenging physics-based gameplay and hours of replay value. Each level requires logic, skill and force to solve!

– Enjoy fun and satisfying slingshot gameplay!
– Play all 8 original Angry Birds episodes from 2012 – over 390 levels!
– 3-star all the levels and hunt for the Golden Eggs!
– All the original classic characters just as you remember them!
– Call in the Mighty Eagle to destroy those hard-to-beat levels!
– No IAPs!
– No intrusive pop-up ads interrupting gameplay!

Relive your first smartphone gaming experience with THE mobile game of mobile games.

We may update the game periodically, for example, to add new features or content or to fix bugs or other technical issues. Please note that the game may not function properly if you do not have the newest version installed. If you have not installed the latest update, Rovio will not be responsible for the game failing to function as expected.
--------
Terms of Use: http://www.rovio.com/eula
Privacy Policy: http://www.rovio.com/privacy

name: MONOPOLY
description:
Play MONOPOLY on the go without distractions – no ads, no fuss! 

Challenge friends, family and fans from around the globe in the digital version of the official MONOPOLY board game, licensed by Hasbro. 

Head online to play your favourite board game with anyone, anywhere, at any time, or compete against state-of-the-art AI opponents offline. Plus, with the seamless PASS & PLAY mode, you can play the classic MONOPOLY board game with your friends with just one device! 

The classic MONOPOLY board game takes a bold leap into a new format, arriving on mobile with amazing graphics, smooth animations and a catchy soundtrack! 


HOW TO PLAY MONOPOLY

1. Download the official MONOPOLY app
2. Press “PLAY”
3. Pick a mode, board, dice and token
4. Roll the dice and move around the board
5. If you land on a property tile, you can buy it
6. Collect rent when other players land on it
7. Continue around the board, drawing cards when instructed – will you be hit with a surprise tax? Sent to jail? Or get a little bonus money? 
8. If you run out of money, you’ll be bankrupt and out of the game
9. The last player left with a profit wins! 

FEATURES

- MONOPOLY ON THE GO – No connection? No problem. Our roster of AI opponents are ready to challenge you! Or play with your friends offline with Pass & Play! 
- MULTIPLE MODES – Take on AI opponents in Single Player or compete against friends and family in Pass & Play or Online With Friends. Try out Online Multiplayer and face off against fellow tycoons from around the world! 
- EXCLUSIVE BOARDS – Experience the iconic board game like never before with exclusive boards and more! 
- AWESOME NEW TOKENS AND DICE – Whatever your style, MONOPOLY has a set of dice fit for a future tycoon! Pick from nostalgic classic tokens or brand-new designs exclusive to the mobile game.

Get the most authentic MONOPOLY experience with the official MONOPOLY mobile game!

The MONOPOLY name and logo, the distinctive design of the gameboard, the four corner squares, the MR. MONOPOLY name and character, as well as each of the distinctive elements of the board and playing pieces are trademarks of Hasbro for its property trading game and game equipment. © 1935, 2025 Hasbro. All Rights Reserved.

name: Bloons TD 6
description:
Craft your perfect defense from a combination of powerful Monkey Towers and awesome Heroes, then pop every last invading Bloon!

Regular massive updates from the same team that built the game makes Bloons TD 6 a favorite for millions of players. Enjoy endless hours of strategy gaming, offline play, online co-op multiplayer, and fun hand-crafted events!

EPIC MONKEY TOWERS & HEROES!
* Place Monkeys to pop Bloons. It's that easy, yes - but the depth and progression is huge!
* 26 powerful Monkey Towers, each with 3 upgrade paths and unique activated abilities.
* 18 diverse Heroes, each with 20 signature upgrades, 2 special abilities, custom voiceovers, plus multiple unlockable skins!
* Paragons! Explore the incredible power of the truly epic Monkey Paragon upgrades.

HUGE UPDATES AND EVENTS!
* Regular updates! We release about 6 huge updates every year with new characters, new maps and mechanics, and whole new ways to play.
* Boss Events! Fearsome Boss Bloons will challenge even the strongest defenses.
* Odysseys! Battle through a series of maps connected by their theme, rules, and rewards.
* Quests! Delve into what makes the Monkeys tick with Quests, crafted to tell tales and share knowledge.
* Contested Territory! Join forces with other players and battle for territory against five other teams. Capture tiles on a shared map and compete on the leaderboards.
* Trophy Store! Earn Trophies to unlock dozens of cosmetic items that let you customize your Monkeys, Bloons, animations, music, and more.
* Content Browser! Create your own Challenges and Odysseys, then share them with other players and check out the most liked and played community content.

ENDLESS AWESOMENESS!
* 4-Player Co-Op! Play every map and mode with up to 3 other players in public or private games.
* Play anywhere - single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t!
* 70+ handcrafted maps, with more added every update.
* Monkey Knowledge! Over 100 meta-upgrades to add power where you need it.
* Powers and Insta Monkeys! Earned through gameplay, events, and achievements. Instantly add power for tricky maps and modes.

We pack as much content and polish into each update as possible, and we’ll continue to add new features, content, and challenges in regular updates.

We truly respect your time and support, and we hope Bloons TD 6 will be the best strategy game you’ve ever played. If it’s not, please contact us at https://support.ninjakiwi.com and tell us what we can do better!

Those Bloons aren't going to pop themselves... sharpen your darts and go play Bloons TD 6!

**********

Ninja Kiwi Notes: 

Please review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. You will be prompted in-game to accept these terms in order to cloud save and protect your game progress:
https://ninjakiwi.com/terms
https://ninjakiwi.com/privacy_policy

Bloons TD 6 contains in-game items that can be purchased with real money. You can disable in-app purchases in your device's settings, or reach us at https://support.ninjakiwi.com for help. Your purchases fund our development updates and new games, and we sincerely appreciate every vote of confidence you give us with your purchases. 

Ninja Kiwi Community:
We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with any feedback, positive or negative, at https://support.ninjakiwi.com.

Streamers and Video Creators: 
Ninja Kiwi is actively promoting channel creators on YouTube and Twitch! If you are not already working with us, keep making videos and tell us about your channel at streamers@ninjakiwi.com.

name: Balatro
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro mobile game!

Hypnotic and endlessly satisfying, Balatro is a magical mix of card games like Solitaire and Poker, that lets you twist the rules in ways never seen before!

Your goal is to beat the Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands.

Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Win enough chips to beat tricky bosses, and find hidden bonus hands and decks as you play. You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices.
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
description:
The Kingdom has fallen. Time has turned back. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past. Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis
The legendary tower defense saga by Ironhide Game Studio returns. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, recruit the heroes who built the kingdom, and stop a young Vez'nan before darkness takes hold.

A PREQUEL, REWRITTEN
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Walk through known battlefields and uncover the moment everything went wrong.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them. Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS. 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.

name: CloverPit
description:
A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a debt simulator!

Clover Pit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!

Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.

Features:
- A gripping rogue-lite where every round could be your last!
- Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups!
- Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode!
- A hellish escape room atmosphere!
- 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck!
- A sinister tale of addiction and escape!

Note on Save Data: This game currently stores progress locally on your device. Please be aware that uninstalling the app (or clearing app data) will delete your save file. Cloud Save & Cross-Device Sync are in development for a future update.

P.S. IS THIS GAMBLING?
No! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money!

name: Scritchy Scratchy
description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:
• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching 
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

name: Slots & Daggers
description:
SLOTS & DAGGERS is a roguelike in a slot machine.

Spin the reels, chain symbols into combos, and turn every pull into damage, gold and upgrades. Build your machine run by run, then take it into the dungeon and fight your way through a weird little fantasy world full of goblins, monsters and strange little guys.
Every spin matters. Every symbol you add changes the odds. And every run ends with the same question: one more?

FEATURES
- A slot machine that fights back – build synergies, break the reels, beat the odds
- A weird fantasy world drawn by hand, in all its crude glory
- 4–8 hour campaign with escalating challenges
- Egg Arena – an endless high-score mode for the truly determined
- Retro visuals with a hand-drawn, lo-fi charm
- Crunchy old-school hip hop drum machine soundtrack
- Quick runs, deep builds – perfect for a session on the go
- No ads, no in-app purchases, no real money involved – just the game

Numbers! Fights! Goblins! And a lot of PLING.

----

A NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPER

After my last game SUMMERHOUSE, I wanted to make something radically different. Still small, but faster, with numbers, fights and goblins! The result is SLOTS & DAGGERS.
To make this game I combined a lot of things I deeply love – weird fantasy worlds, crude drawings of strange little guys, old school crunchy hip hop drum machines and addictive arcade games that go "PLING PLING PLING" as they spit out little coins – with classic roguelike mechanics.
As with SUMMERHOUSE, please keep in mind this game is a solo project – small, focused, and made with care. It's meant to be short and sweet and doesn't have the amount of content as games built by bigger teams over years, but I think it's a fair deal!
I hope you have a good time with SLOTS & DAGGERS!

Cheers,
Friedemann

name: After Inc.
description:
Can you rebuild civilization after a zombie apocalypse? From the creator of Plague Inc. comes a unique blend of strategic simulation, survival city builder and ‘mini 4X’.

Decades after the Necroa Virus ravaged humanity, a few survivors emerge. Build a settlement, explore, scavenge resources and expand as you shape your post-apocalyptic society. The world is green and beautiful but danger lurks in the ruins!

After Inc. is the brand new game from the creator of ‘Plague Inc.’ - one of the most popular games ever with over 190 million players. Brilliantly executed with beautiful graphics and critically acclaimed gameplay - After Inc. is engaging and easy to learn. Build multiple settlements and gain abilities in a persistent campaign to lead humanity out of the darkness.

Public Service Announcement: Unlike our other games, I’m pleased to say that After Inc. is not based on any real world situation. No need to start worrying about a real life zombie apocalypse yet… 

◈◈◈ What happens after Plague Inc.? ◈◈◈

Features:
● Make difficult decisions - Are children an unaffordable luxury? Are dogs pets or a food source? Democracy or Authoritarianism?
● Explore a beautiful post-apocalyptic United Kingdom
● Exploit the ruins of the past to scavenge / harvest resources
● Expand your Settlement with housing, farms, lumberyards and much more
● Exterminate zombie infestations and defend humanity
● Uncover old technologies and research new ones
● Shape your society and provide services to keep your people happy
● Build multiple settlements in a persistent campaign and level up abilities
● Ultra realistic modelling of Zombie behaviour based on real life studies… :P
● Sophisticated narrative algorithms shaped by your decisions
● 5 unique leaders with radically different abilities
● Internet connectivity not required
● No ‘consumable microtransactions. Expansion Packs are ‘buy once, play forever’
●Will be updated for years to come.

Special sale price to celebrate the launch of the game!


◈◈◈


I’ve got lots of plans for updates! Get in touch and let me know what you want to see.

James (the designer)


Contact me here:

www.ndemiccreations.com/en/1-support
www.twitter.com/NdemicCreations

name: Football Chairman Pro 2
description:
Football Chairman is back and it's bigger than ever!

Create a football club from scratch, starting as a tiny non-league team, and see if you can make it through seven divisions to the very top.

See your players win play-offs, cup competitions and eventually conquer Europe and the World!

Hire and fire managers, develop your stadium, negotiate transfers, contracts and sponsorship deals... while keeping the fans and the bank manager happy.

Over three million users have downloaded the Football Chairman games since launch, and they have won multiple app store awards.

Football Chairman Pro 2 is the newest and most in-depth version of the game, which is updated every season free of charge with the very latest data!

FC Pro 2 retains the fast-paced, addictive gameplay that made the earlier versions so popular, while adding a whole host of new features, including:

- Updated domestic, European and international cup competitions for 2026/27
- Compete with clubs from all over the globe in a World Team Cup
- Load or create updated datapacks featuring teams from all over the world
- Design your club's home, away and goalkeeper shirts each season
- No time limits or adverts, and all in-app purchases are 100% optional
- Managers have more detailed profiles, including age, personality and preferences
- Negotiate manager contracts and renewals
- Take over 'real' teams or go back to your previous clubs
- More flexibility over signings with a new 'Transfer shortlist'
- 'Hall of Fame' to honour your club's greatest ever players
- New 'Financial Fair Play' challenge scenario to test your skills
- More detailed financial insights to help you manage your club's money
- 99 achievements to aim for, including 49 brand new ones
- Trophy Cabinet to show off your club's silverware
- Redesigned interface
- Plus thousands of other improvements to the gameplay!

Good luck... you'll need it!

name: Earn to Die 2
description:
Drive your car through a zombie apocalypse in this massive follow-up to the chart-topping hit Earn to Die!

An evacuation ship is waiting on the other side of the country. The only thing that stands in your way: city after city overrun by zombies . With only a run-down car and a small amount of cash you face a familiar situation... to drive through hordes of zombies in order to survive!

BRAND NEW STORY MODE
Earn to Die 2 introduces a massive new Story Mode, five times longer than its predecessor. The game departs its familiar desert setting and delves into the depths of cities infested by zombies. 

MULTI-TIERED LEVELS:
Levels are now multi-tiered! Drive across decayed highway overpasses, via underground tunnels, or smash through epic zombie filled factories. Whichever path you choose to take, you won't be able to escape the zombie hordes - your only choice is to smash through them!

BUILD A ZOMBIE-SLAUGHTERING MACHINE
Unlock and upgrade 10 different vehicles, including a sports car, a fire truck, and even an ice-cream van. Each vehicle can be equipped with a range of upgrades, such as armored frames, roof-mounted guns, boosters and more. Those zombies will stand no chance.

DESTRUCTIBLE VEHICLES
Vehicles are now fully destructible. Hang on for your life as your vehicle gets smashed to smithereens if you aren't too careful.

MORE ZOMBIES. MORE DESTRUCTION. MORE MAYHEM.
What are you waiting for? That rescue ship isn't going to wait forever! Prepare yourself for a wild ride - and seriously, there is nothing like smashing through zombie-filled factories!

name: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description:
***PLEASE NOTE: This game is officially supported on the following devices only: iPhone 4s, 5, 5s, 5c, 6, 6s, 6 Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, iPod Touch 6th Gen, iPad Mini 1, 2, 3 & 4, iPad 2, 3rd Gen, 4th Gen, iPad Air 1 & 2, and iPad Pro.***


Five years ago, Carl Johnson escaped from the pressures of life in Los Santos, San Andreas, a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs and corruption. Where filmstars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers.

Now, it’s the early 90’s. Carl’s got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.

On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide. CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet with a vast open-world covering the state of San Andreas and its three major cities – Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas – with enhanced visual fidelity and over 70 hours of gameplay.

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas features:  
• Remastered, high-resolution graphics built specifically for mobile including lighting enhancements, an enriched color palette and improved character models. 
• Enhanced for the iPhone 5 series and iPad 4th Gen and above with dynamic detailed shadows and real-time environmental reflections.
• Physical controller support for all Made for iOS controllers.
• Cloud save support for playing across all your iOS devices for Rockstar Social Club Members.
• Dual analog stick controls for full camera and movement control.
• Three different control schemes and customizable controls with contextual options to display buttons only when you need them.

Languages Supported: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian and Japanese. 

*To listen to your custom playlist, simply create a playlist titled “GTASA”, launch the game, and select the radio station “MIXTAPE”.  

Mobile Version developed by War Drum Studios
www.wardrumstudios.com

Find out more:
www.rockstargames.com

See videos:
www.youtube.com/rockstargames

Follow us:
www.facebook.com/rockstargames
www.twitter.com/rockstargames

name: Tenable
description:
Warwick Davis challenges you to take on a series of exciting Top 10 lists in the hit ITV quiz show Tenable!

Brought to you by the developers of the chart-topping Tipping Point and The Chase, Tenable takes quiz Apps to new fun-packed heights.

Featuring all six rounds from the show, will you rise to the challenge and take home the virtual top prize of £125,000?

•	Full running commentary by Warwick Davis
•	Hundreds of entertaining Top 10 lists to play
•	Play Solo or in a Team (on one device)
•	Brand new Quick Play and VS Modes
•	Packed with fun facts from Warwick
•	Achievements and Leaderboards
•	Optional Music, Sport, and TV & Film packs to purchase

Have you got what it takes to score a Perfect 10?

We hope you love Tenable and consider leaving us a 5-star review. If not, please let us know what we can do better at barnstormgames.helpshift.com or from within the App.

name: Incredibox
description:
Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy swing, Brazilian rhythms and much more. As well, discover a selection of mods created by the community. Plenty to keep you mixing for hours, with no ads or microtransactions.

Part game, part tool, Incredibox is above all an audio and visual experience that has quickly become a hit with people of all ages. The right mix of music, graphics, animation and interactivity makes Incredibox ideal for everyone. And because it makes learning fun and entertaining, Incredibox is now being used by schools all over the world.

How to play? Easy! Drag and drop icons onto the avatars to make them sing and start to compose your own music. Find the right sound combos to unlock animated choruses that will enhance your tune.

Once your composition sounds great, just save it and share it to get as many votes as possible. If you get enough votes, you may go down in Incredibox history by joining the Top 50 chart! Ready to show your stuff?

You can also download your mix as an MP3 from the app and listen to it over and over again!

Too lazy to create your own mix? No problem, just let the automatic mode play for you!

Pump it up and chill ;)

****************
Incredibox, the brainchild of Lyon, France-based studio So Far So Good, was created in 2009. Starting out as a webpage, it was then released as a mobile and tablet app and became an instant hit. It has won several awards and appeared in various international media, including: BBC, Adobe, FWA, Gizmodo, Slate, Konbini, Softonic, Kotaku, Cosmopolitan, PocketGamer, AppAdvice, AppSpy, Vice, Ultralinx and many others. The online demo has attracted more than 100 million visitors since its creation.

name: Mini Metro
description:
Mini Metro, the sublime subway simulator, now on iPhone and iPad.

• Included in the App Store Best of 2016
• Mac Game of the Year in over 30 countries
• BAFTA-nominated
• IGF award-winning
• IGN Mobile Game of the Year nominee
• Included in Gamespot's Best Mobile Games of 2016

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

• Random city growth means each game is unique.
• Over two dozen of real-world cities to test your planning skills.
• A variety of upgrades so you can tailor your network.
• Normal mode for quick scored games, Endless to relax, or Extreme for the ultimate challenge.
• Build your metro exactly how you want to with the Creative mode.
• Compete against the world every day in the Daily Challenge.
• Colourblind and night modes.
• Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace.

name: Farming Simulator 26 Mobile
description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.

name: Bloons TD 5
description:
Five-star tower defense with unrivaled depth and replayability. Now with rewarded leaderboards for even more fun and challenge!

The Bloons are back and this time they mean business! Build awesome towers, choose your favorite upgrades, hire cool new Special Agents, and pop every last invading Bloon!

Featuring 2 brand new Towers, cool Special Agents, glorious retina graphics, original Tracks and Special Missions, a whole new tier of Specialty Building upgrades, and the powerful Monkey Lab to further upgrade your towers, Bloons TD 5 delivers hours and hours of fun, challenging play to fans and new players alike.

Hours and Hours of Awesome Gameplay:
* 90+ Tracks
* 21 powerful towers with Activated Abilities and 2 upgrade paths
* 10 Special Agents
* Online Co-op play
* Multi-track Odyssey Challenges
* Boss Bloon Special Events
* 10 Special Missions
* 250+ Random Missions
* Daily Challenges
* New Bloon enemies - tougher Camos, Regrow Bloons, and the fearsome ZOMG
* 50+ Game Center Achievements and Challenges
* iCloud Support
* 3 different game modes
* Freeplay mode after mastering a track
* 4 difficulty settings and family-friendly theme so anyone can play

And that's just the beginning - regular planned updates will keep Bloons TD 5 fresh, fun, and challenging for many months to come. Now it's time to pop some Bloons!

Remember to save to iCloud after each victory or purchase to save your progress. 

iPad version also available - check out Bloons TD 5 HD for full screen UI awesomeness!

https://ninjakiwi.com/terms

name: Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp C
description:
The original Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp game was released in 2017. This new one-time purchase app is packed with items and events that were released over the course of seven years. It keeps the general game play of Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp without additional in-game purchases.

As a campsite manager, it's up to you to build a fun campsite. While working as the manager, you can also fish, catch bugs, chat with animals, and collect your favorite furniture.
You can also change into your favorite outfit, make lots of detours, and enjoy your relaxing camp life!

◆ Decorate your campsite with over 10,000 items
From tents and swings to lazy rivers and merry-go-rounds, there are tons of items you can use to decorate your campsite with to your taste.

◆ Meet the animals
A lot of animals with quirky personalities will make an appearance. The animals are very curious about your campsite. The animal pal you choose as a camp caretaker will help you with your job. Walk around the forest together and get inspiration on how to build a lovely campsite.

◆ Tons of seasonal events
There will be lots of events such as Garden Events and Fishing Tourneys every month. Don't forget Halloween, Toy Day, Bunny Day, and the Summer Festival. Jump into these events to collect seasonal items.

==========New Game Play Added to the Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete Game==========

◆ Camper Cards
You can create a Camper Card that introduces you. Pick a color and pose and it's done. You can also scan other players' Camper Cards and enjoy trading and collecting. 

◆ Gatherings at the Whistle Pass
You can visit a new place that didn't exist in Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp. Other players whose Camper Cards you registered will come visit. Enjoy music, with a nightly live guitar performance by K.K. Slider.

◆ Complete Ticket
When you participate in events, you can earn Complete Tickets. Exchange them for limited-edition items that you missed out on or fortune cookies of your choice.

◆ Enjoy Custom Designs
You can scan Custom Designs created in the Animal Crossing: New Horizons game for the Nintendo Switch system, then wear or otherwise use them in the app.

※Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete only supports downloading Custom Designs. You cannot create new Custom Designs in the app.

Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete is packed with fun. Decorate your dream campsite!

※Although constant online connection is not required, temporary data communication may be required for the following processes, which may result in data communication usage.
　・ Communicating with your Nintendo Account
　・ Updating the time
　・ Downloading data such as software updates

※Some events may not function properly if you change the time on your device.

※Save data will be saved onto your device.

※Please note that if you delete the app, save data will also be deleted.

※Operation is not guaranteed for all devices that meet the operating conditions. It may not work properly depending on the device's performance and specifications, device-specific application usage conditions, etc.

※Certain items from Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp will not be available in Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete.

※Custom Designs can be applied to clothing, umbrellas, uchiwa fans, handheld flags, face-cutout standees, and path/flooring.

May include advertising.

name: The Past Within
description:
Note: The Past Within is a co-op only game. Both players need to own a copy of the game on their own device (mobile, tablet or computer), as well as a way to communicate with each other. Play together with a friend or find a partner on our official Discord server!

The past and future cannot be explored alone! Team up with a friend and piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives! 

The Past Within is the first co-op only point-and-click adventure set in the mysterious world of Rusty Lake.

Features:

▪ A co-op experience 
Play together with a friend, one in The Past, the other in The Future. Work together to solve the puzzles and help Rose set her father’s plan in motion!
▪ Two worlds - Two perspectives 
Both players will experience their environments in two different dimensions: 2D as well as in 3D - a first-time experience in the Rusty Lake universe!
▪ Cross-platform
As long as you can communicate with each other, you and your partner of choice can each play The Past Within on your preferred platform: Mac, PC and Nintendo Switch!
▪ Playtime & Replayability
The game contains 2 chapters and has an average play-time of 2 hours. For the full experience, we recommend replaying the game from the other perspective. Plus you can use our replayability feature for a fresh start with new solutions to all puzzles.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
description:
EXPERIENCE THE ULTIMATE FLIGHT SIMULATOR ON YOUR MOBILE DEVICE!

Immerse yourself in the captivating world of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator. Our cutting-edge flight simulation technology allows you to experience the thrill of being a pro pilot from your device. Whether you want realistic airplane games or a professional flight simulator, RFS delivers an unparalleled journey.

FLY NOW, ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD!

Learn to take off, land, and complete full flights in a global flight simulation environment. Explore aircraft with 3D live cockpits, visit 30 HD airports, and navigate 500 SD airports. Personalize instruments, use automatic flight plans, and experience the finest detail in this global flight simulator. Master your skills with our pilot tutorials and become a master of flight simulation!
Manual/Tutorial: Real Flight Simulator Wiki
UNLOCK THE FULL REAL FLIGHT SIMULATOR EXPERIENCE
Choose the subscription that fits: monthly, six-month, or yearly. Join virtual aviators and access premium features in the most advanced airplane simulator and flight simulator available on the App Store.

BUCKLE UP AND BECOME A REAL PILOT!

As a pro pilot in our flight simulator, you will enjoy a vast array of features for the ultimate flight simulation:
• 60+ AIRPLANE MODELS: Take command of airplane models with realistic 3D cockpits and authentic lighting. Experience pilot systems and instruments in every flight.
• 1900+ HD AIRPORTS: Land your airplane at 3D airports featuring realistic buildings, vehicles, and authentic ground procedures. This is the most detailed airport simulation in a mobile flight simulator.
• REAL-TIME FLIGHTS & WEATHER: Join 40,000+ real-time flights daily with live air traffic at global hubs. Experience real-time weather that challenges your pilot skills in this realistic flight simulator.
• DETAILED CHECKLISTS: Follow authentic pilot procedures for takeoff and landing to fully immerse yourself in the flight simulation.
• ADVANCED GROUND SYSTEMS: Interact with refueling trucks, passenger vehicles, and follow-me cars upon landing your airplane.
• ADVANCED FLIGHT PLANNING: Customize real-time weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots for a connected flight simulation community.
• AUTOPILOT & ASSISTED LANDING: Utilize precise autopilot and our Automatic Landing System for long-haul airplane missions.
• REALISTIC SATELLITE SCENERY: Explore the world with high-definition satellite terrain and height maps in stunning 3D. This is global flight simulation at its finest.

ENGAGE IN GLOBAL MULTIPLAYER MODES

• Join hundreds of other pilots and fly together in any part of the world.
• Chat with fellow multiplayer pilots, participate in weekly events, and join Virtual Airlines (VA) to earn Flight Points. RFS is the premier multiplayer flight simulator.

ATC MODE: BECOME AN AIR TRAFFIC CONTROLLER

• ATC GAME MODE: Organize aircraft traffic, give instructions, and guide planes to fly safely.
• Enjoy interactive multi-voice ATC procedures and communications. Experience the dual role of pilot and controller in one simulation.

CREATE AND SHARE YOUR AVIATION PASSION

• CUSTOMIZE YOUR PLANE: Design your own airplane liveries and share them globally.
• DESIGN YOUR AIRPORT: Model your favorite HD airport, and watch other pilots take off from your creation in the flight simulator.
• PLANE SPOTTING: Capture your favorite planes. Experience city lights at night and the ethereal play of light and clouds during sunrise and sunset.
• Join the Real Flight Simulator community, discover new flight routes, and interact with aviation enthusiasts.

REAL-TIME SIMULATION REQUIREMENTS

Internet Connection is required for the full scope of aviation experiences and multiplayer features.

GET READY TO SOAR THE SKIES!

Buckle up and become a Real Pilot in RFS - Real Flight Simulator!

TERMS OF USE: https://www.rortos.com/terms-of-use/
Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: Tipping Point
description:
No.1 Game on iPhone and iPad!

Finally it's your chance to take on the extraordinary Tipping Point machine in the official App of the hit ITV game show!  

Test your quiz knowledge and push your counters over the Tipping Point for a winning game!

• Play with up to 4 players (on one device)
• Features all the rounds from the show
   ◦ On The Buzzer

name: Adventure To Fate: Dungeons
description:
A Turn-based Roguelite Dungeon Crawler unlike any other. Built on over a decade of handcrafted systems and content, now expanded with new roguelike mechanics, dungeons, quests, and deeper progression than ever before.
Battle through 4 unique dungeons, each with its own design, enemies, loot, play modes, and storylines:
-The Crypt of Fate - Begin in the blighted Cemetery and descend into haunted catacombs where the dark entity Thanatos once rose.

-The Lost Sands - A scorching desert hides ancient magic beneath shifting dunes. Explore forgotten temples, cursed ruins, and face monsters awakened from the past.

-The Frozen Spire - A tower of frost and shadow where icy magic corrupts everything it touches.

-(NEW) The Infernal Volcano - Journey through rivers of magma and face infernal corruption before darkness consumes the realm.

Each dungeon features FOUR play modes:
-Casual (3 lives per run)

-Champion (true roguelike permadeath)

-Mystic Mode (a dungeon-specific challenge mode with mysterious mechanics)

-Hellish Mode (The Ultimate Challenge mode: No Gold Drops, Potions can only be used in battle, and No Remorse)

Deep Character Customization & Progression
-9 Starting Classes: Paladin, Witch, Assassin, Naturalist, Shadow Ranger, Thief, Monk, Death Knight, Illusionist, and more to come!

-7 Crafting Professions (Weaponsmith, Armorsmith, Leather Worker, Tailor, Alchemist, Jeweler, and Enchanter) with unique crafts for each Dungeon!

-Unlock additional classes, races, and spirits through achievements and quests

-Choose from over 1000 handcrafted skills and spells across a wide range of archetypes

-Discover 50+ Spirits who fight alongside you and can be customized with gear and passive abilities

-Over 100 Quests to complete, each with Unique Rewards to unlock.

-Global Leaderboards and Obituaries to track others' progress... or deaths.


A World Built for Replayability
-Item & Monster Prefixes - Equipment and enemies can have unique prefixes that add new stats, spells, and effects, drastically increasing loot variety and encounter dynamics

-Custom Forge System - Create weapons and armor with your own stats, icons, and names, then find them in future runs

-Quest & Achievement System - Daily quests, class boards, and over 200 unlockable goals turn every run into progression

-Monster Bestiary - Track every enemy, skill, and loot drop to improve strategies

-20 Shrine Events to encounter (Skill Shrines, Death Shrines, Curse Shrines, Crafting Shrines, Shops, and More!)

Content-Rich, Handcrafted World
-1000s of handcrafted items, skills, NPCs, enemies, maps, and story events

-Unlimited replayability with unique randomized dungeons each run!

-Constant updates and additions based on player feedback!


Built from the Ground Up for Accessibility (VoiceOver Support)
-Fully VoiceOver supported with detailed narration and intuitive screen navigation

-Every menu, battle, and interaction is carefully designed to work with touch and screen readers

-Designed for immersion: responsive combat sounds, audio cues for direction, and dynamic environmental narration

-Optional vibration feedback enhances immersion and accessibility with distinct alerts for key events.

-Enhanced action & battle logs help VoiceOver users track everything from item equips to quest progress.

Additional Features
-Epic rock RPG soundtrack & music player by Aaron Cloutier

-Autosave and Offline play

-Retro pixel art mixed with modern polish

-Designed specifically for iOS devices and Portrait Play. 

-An active Discord community for help or suggestions

-50+ Gamecenter leaderboards and Achievements

Whether you're a casual RPG fan or a hardcore roguelike veteran, Adventure To Fate: Dungeons offers endless progression, deep strategy, and exciting loot-driven gameplay.
And for visually impaired players, this is a full-featured, immersive RPG made just for you by players just like you.
Thanks for Supporting Accessible and Indie Game Development!

name: Cluedo: Classic Edition
description:
The original murder mystery invites you to a dinner party to die for…

Step into the shoes of your favourite cast of classy criminal characters – Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Reverend Green, Professor Plum, Mrs Peacock and Dr Orchid – and explore the iconic rooms of the Tudor Mansion, rendered in stunning 3D like never before. 

Play against challenging AI opponents, or go online to challenge Cluedo fans from around the world. You can even set up a nostalgic games night with your friends and family in Private Multiplayer! 

Whodunit? With what weapon? Where? There’s six suspects, six weapons, nine rooms, and only one answer…

HOW TO PLAY CLUEDO: CLASSIC EDITION: 
1. Three cards are hidden away at the start of the game – these cards are the solution to the crime.
2. Each player gets three Clue Cards. These can’t be part of the solution, so they are automatically crossed off your clue sheet. 
3. Roll the dice and move your token around the board.
4. If you choose to enter a room, you can make a suggestion. Pick who you think committed the crime, with what weapon and where. 
5. Each player then takes it in turn to compare your suggestion against the cards they hold. If they have a card that features in your suggestion, they’ll tell you. 
6. Cross off any cards other players have shown you and whittle down your list of suspects.
7. When you are ready, you can make an accusation! If your accusation is wrong, you’re out of the game!

FEATURES
- CROSS-PLATFORM MULTIPLAYER – Play with your friends and family on PC, mobile and Nintendo Switch.
- ONLINE LEADERBOARDS – Outsmart fans around the world with weekly online leaderboards.
- MULTIPLE MODES – Face up to six players in Online Multiplayer, or take on customisable AI suspects in Single Player Mode. 
- PRIVATE LOBBIES – Set up a family game night easily with the Play with Friends Mode.

Catch the criminal! Play Cluedo: Classic Edition today!

name: Total War: MEDIEVAL II
description:
READ BEFORE BUYING: Please expand this description and read the full list of supported devices below to confirm that your device is supported.

MEDIEVAL II brings Total War’s compelling mix of massive real-time battles and intricate turn-based strategy to iPhone and iPad. Set across three continents during the turbulent Middle Ages, spectacular conflicts and scheming rivals line the path to power as the great kingdoms of the medieval world vie for supremacy. Be it through diplomacy or conquest, trade or subterfuge, you must secure the resources and loyalty required to rule an empire from the shores of Western Europe to the sands of Arabia.

THE STRENGTH OF NATIONS
Unlock up to 17 playable factions and build them into major world powers through statecraft, subterfuge or all-out war.

THE KINGDOMS EXPANSION
Available via in-app purchase, this massive expansion includes 24 playable factions across four unique, fully featured campaigns. Wage war from the jungles of the Americas to the deserts of the Holy Land, from the deceptively gentle shores of the British Isles to the frigid Baltic plains.

THE HOTSEATS & HALBERDS UPDATE
This major update adds a host of balance improvements to Pikemen, Zweihanders and other late-era units, and, for owners of the Kingdoms expansion, introduces asynchronous multiplayer campaigns on a single device.

THE ART OF WAR
Deploy infantry, archers and cavalry into huge real-time battles, with a full range of medieval weaponry at your command.

THE TOOLS OF STATE
Use sophisticated diplomacy, lucrative trade agreements and daring agents to forge alliances or destabilise your rivals.

THE TEST OF TIME
Shape the destinies of Europe, North Africa and the Middle East through five momentous centuries of combat, competition and conquest.

THE POWER IN YOUR HANDS
Take command, with a brand-new user interface and enhanced touch controls for fingertip control of the battlefield. Or, play with any iPadOS-compatible mouse & keyboard.

===

Total War: MEDIEVAL II requires iOS 16 or later. You need 4.3GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.

A further 7.65GB is required to install the Kingdoms DLC. To save space, you can install each campaign individually.

Americas: 2.06GB
Britannia: 1.66GB
